datasets.name: dq_rules
queryLines:
SELECT
  layer,
  table_name,
  check_category,
  check_name,
  threshold_pct,
  rule_description,
  rationale,
  silver_action,
  blocking,
  denominator_scope
FROM
  `nyc_mobility`.nyc_quality.dq_rules
ORDER BY
  layer,
  table_name,
  check_category

datasets.name: latest_results
queryLines:
SELECT
  layer,
  table_name,
  check_category,
  check_name,
  failed_rows,
  total_rows,
  failed_pct,
  threshold_pct,
  status
FROM
  `nyc_mobility`.nyc_quality.vw_current_batch_dq
ORDER BY
  CASE status
    WHEN 'FAIL' THEN 0
    WHEN 'WARN' THEN 1
    ELSE 2
  END,
  failed_pct DESC

datasets.name: failures_detail
queryLines:
SELECT
  d.layer,
  d.table_name,
  d.check_name,
  d.check_category,
  d.failed_rows,
  d.total_rows,
  d.failed_pct,
  d.threshold_pct,
  d.status,
  r.blocking,
  r.silver_action,
  r.rule_description,
  r.rationale,
  CASE
    WHEN
      d.status = 'FAIL'
      AND r.blocking = true
    THEN
      'BLOCKING FAIL'
    WHEN d.status = 'FAIL' THEN 'FAIL (recorded)'
    ELSE d.status
  END AS severity
FROM
  `nyc_mobility`.nyc_quality.vw_current_batch_dq d
    LEFT JOIN `nyc_mobility`.nyc_quality.dq_rules r
      ON d.layer = r.layer
      AND d.table_name = r.table_name
      AND d.check_name = r.check_name
WHERE
  d.status <> 'PASS'
ORDER BY
  CASE
    WHEN r.blocking = true THEN 0
    ELSE 1
  END,
  d.failed_pct DESC

datasets.name: run_history
queryLines:
SELECT
  run_id,
  run_ts,
  layer,
  tables_checked,
  checks_run,
  checks_passed,
  checks_warned,
  checks_failed,
  overall_status,
  finished_at
FROM
  `nyc_mobility`.nyc_quality.dq_run_log
ORDER BY
  run_ts DESC

datasets.name: latest_run
queryLines:
SELECT
  run_id,
  run_ts,
  layer,
  tables_checked,
  checks_run,
  checks_passed,
  checks_warned,
  checks_failed,
  overall_status,
  finished_at
FROM
  `nyc_mobility`.nyc_quality.vw_latest_dq_run
ORDER BY
  layer

datasets.name: rationale_tags
queryLines:
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN rationale LIKE 'SOURCE_SPEC%' THEN 'SOURCE_SPEC'
    WHEN rationale LIKE 'PIPELINE_INVARIANT%' THEN 'PIPELINE_INVARIANT'
    WHEN rationale LIKE 'BUSINESS_RULE%' THEN 'BUSINESS_RULE'
    WHEN rationale LIKE 'OBSERVED%' THEN 'OBSERVED'
    WHEN rationale LIKE 'ADVISORY%' THEN 'ADVISORY'
    WHEN rationale LIKE 'AT_REST%' THEN 'AT_REST'
    ELSE 'untagged'
  END AS rationale_tag,
  layer
FROM
  `nyc_mobility`.nyc_quality.dq_rules
WHERE
  layer IN ('bronze', 'silver', 'gold')

datasets.name: blocking_count
queryLines:
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS blocking_failures
FROM
  `nyc_mobility`.nyc_quality.vw_current_batch_dq d
    JOIN `nyc_mobility`.nyc_quality.dq_rules r
      ON d.layer = r.layer
      AND d.table_name = r.table_name
      AND d.check_name = r.check_name
WHERE
  d.status = 'FAIL'
  AND r.blocking = true

datasets.name: gold_run_summary
queryLines:
SELECT
  checks_run,
  checks_passed,
  checks_warned,
  checks_failed,
  overall_status
FROM
  `nyc_mobility`.nyc_quality.vw_latest_dq_run
WHERE
  layer = 'gold'

datasets.name: gold_results
queryLines:
SELECT
  table_name,
  check_category,
  check_name,
  failed_rows,
  total_rows,
  failed_pct,
  threshold_pct,
  status
FROM
  `nyc_mobility`.nyc_quality.vw_current_batch_dq
WHERE
  layer = 'gold'
ORDER BY
  CASE status
    WHEN 'FAIL' THEN 0
    WHEN 'WARN' THEN 1
    ELSE 2
  END,
  failed_pct DESC

datasets.name: gold_at_rest
queryLines:
SELECT
  check_name,
  failed_rows,
  total_rows,
  failed_pct,
  threshold_pct,
  status
FROM
  `nyc_mobility`.nyc_quality.vw_current_batch_dq
WHERE
  layer = 'gold'
  AND check_category = 'at_rest_integrity'
ORDER BY
  failed_rows DESC
